text:
Aisha (PM): quick callout 17: we need to pick between two tradeoffs for the 6/30 ship: full multi-tenant embeddings cache (high perf but risky) vs. prompt-templating (UX win). ACME pilot wants embeddings. options: X) ship a stripped, non-cached embeddings path with rate limits; Y) gate embeddings to an invite-only pilot on dedicated infra; Z) cut embeddings and keep templating. input?
Ravi (Eng): infra context 19: kv-cache bug for long sequences still flakey. stripped stateless embeddings is fastest (approx 3-4 dev days) and avoids cache churn. full cache is 10+ days + infra risk.
Lena (ML): stripped path reduces recall ~5-7% vs full cache but is stable for eval. Pilot-only keeps higher quality for select customers.
Noah (Design): templating is high impact for onboarding but not blocking for early adopters. If we deprioritize it, I can add clearer prompt examples in the UI quickly.
Priya (CS): ACME says "need embeddings" or they'll delay pilot. They'll accept invite-only but prefer not to wait. They also want a rollback plan and SLA expectations.
Aisha (PM): leaning to X (stripped global with rate limits) because it keeps launch date and meets ACME if we document limits. Y reduces blast radius but delays. Vote?
Ravi (Eng): X. put it behind a default-on quota and emergency kill-switch.
Lena (ML): X, with continuous recall probes and a dashboard to watch quality.
Noah (Design): X, Ill ship compact prompt samples to mitigate UX loss.
Priya (CS): Y preferred, but will take X if SLA + onboarding scheduled.
Aisha (PM): consensus: X with conditions: 1) rate limits and default quota 2) monitoring + recall probes 3) customer comms + onboarding for ACME 4) infra rollback toggle. Actions: @Ravi implement stripped path + rate-limits + rollback ticket; @Lena add eval job and dashboard; @Noah ship prompt kit; @Priya schedule ACME call and draft SLA; I'll update milestone tracker.
deploy-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds-stripped (staged=false)
Ravi (Eng): opened INFRA-2044 for rollback toggle. PR for stripped path WIP.
Aisha (PM): filing cut note now: "MVP: ship non-cached embeddings with strict quotas; defer multi-tenant cache to v1; deprioritize prompt-templating to post-MVP." tagging @launch-team. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
